english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for machines that operate by themselves and, in rule-based contexts, consequences that happen automatically.
Use this when mechanical means automatic, that is, when something operates or responds without human control rather than merely seeming formulaic.

examples.english: This washing machine has an automatic shut-off function.
examples.traditional: 呢部洗衣機有自動停機功能。
